Also, Assistant US Attorney Connor Fox attempts to use Eli's daughter Marissa, as leverage in the case against Peter while the power struggle at Lockhart, Agos and Lee reaches a boiling point.

19.o: Alicia and Lucca travel to Toronto to represent NSA agent Jeff Delinger (Zach Woods) who was detained by customs officers while attempting to re-enter the United States. Also, Diane grows concerned when her husband, Kurt McVeigh (Gary Cole), decides to retire and sell his business to Holly Westfall (Megan Hilty), a rival business owner. Peter contemplates an uncertain future when faced with a possible arrest.

20.o: Alicia’s night goes from bad to worse when she throws a party to celebrate Howard and Jackie’s upcoming wedding. Also, Eli asks Jason to investigate Peter in preparation for his trial.

21.o: As Peter's trial begins, Alicia works desperately to keep her husband from returning to jail. Also, Diane and Lucca move aggressively to expand the law firm, but face serious opposition from David Lee.

22.o: Peter has little time left to make a plea deal before the jury comes back with a verdict. Meanwhile, Alicia must decide whether her future is with Peter or with Jason, and she channels the ghost of Will Gardner to help make a decision.

1.o: Bell's back with a new adventure! When the powerful leader of the Apollo Familia takes notice of him, his life with his Goddess is under threat.

2.o: Apollo Familia has laid down their challenge, but Hestia refuses. Apollo tries to force her hand...

3.o: Bell goes to train for the War Game, and it's up to the rest of the party to rescue Lili. Hestia puts her plan into action, but Lili refuses to leave the Soma Familia.

4.o: It's time for the War Games, and the Hestia Family, and its new members, are ready. Can they defeat the entire Apollo Familia and save Bell from Apollo's clutches?

5.o: The Hestia Familia was victorious in their battle against Apollo, and now they've won a huge mansion and a giant pile of cash! Hestia sets out to recruit for the Familia, but there's something she's forgetting...

6.o: Bell is caught up in a new adventure that takes him to the seedy underbelly of Orario: the pleasure quarters.

7.o: With the help of Haruhime the Renard, Bell escapes from the Amazoness prostitutes. But he begins to wonder about Haruhime, who says she was forced to be a prostitute against her will and isn't worth being saved.

8.o: Bell decides he's going to get money in the dungeon to purchase Haruhime. But he runs into a trap when the Ishtar Familia decides to kidnap him.

9.o: With the true purpose of the ritual and the killing stone revealed, Bell decides that he's going to take any risk to save Haruhime.

10.t: Argonaut | Longing to Be a Hero
10.o: The Ishtar Familia's plan has been found out by Freya, who launches a raid on their home. Just when things are bad enough for Bell, their interference brings even more chaos!

11.o: With Haruhime safe at the Familia, things begin to calm down. But when Hestia makes a casual pass at Bell and he shuts her down hard, she runs out of the mansion and into the waiting arms of kidnappers!

12.t: Song of Love | Goddess and Child
12.o: Bell and Hestia spend a relaxing few days at a village in the wilderness, and participate in a local festival. Bell ponders what to do about his relationship with his immortal Goddess, and if he really is ready to love her.

1.o: Four new first-year residents are immediately put to work by the ER's tough-minded residency director Dr. Leanne Rorish.

2.o: Christa saves a woman's life and then pleads with Neal to perform a surgery that will save the patient's reproductive future. Meanwhile, Mario gets into a fight with a patient after he delivers a diagnosis that could end the man's hockey career.

3.o: The doctors work 36 consecutive hours in code black and must deal with a distraught mother of two sons who were in a devastating car accident. Meanwhile, Mario bullies Angus into performing an unnecessary operation and lets Angus take the blame when Leanne finds out.

4.o: A new surgical attending Cole Guthrie joins Angels Memorial with the help of his estranged father and clashes with Leanne over their contrasting approaches to medicine. Christa has a crisis of confidence in the middle of a procedure on her first infant since the loss of her son.

5.o: Neal clashes with his neurosurgeon father over how to treat his gravely ill mother, whose mysterious symptoms force Angels Memorial to quarantine Trauma One.

6.o: Leanne must deal with the difficult decision of whether to save Tom Moreno (Michael Trucco), the police officer who helped her during her family's accident, or his shooter, who has more serious injuries. Also, when Malaya's pregnant ex-girlfriend, Carla Niven (Shiri Appleby), arrives at the hospital with pain in her arm, Malaya is shocked by her MRI results.

7.o: Angus utilizes his background in psychology when a woman cannot remember how she injured herself and others; Christa bonds with the mother of a patient with cystic fibrosis.

8.o: Christa must handle all emergencies at Angels Memorial that happen outside the emergency room; Malaya arranges a bone marrow drive for Carla; Leanne turns down a date.

9.o: When the lead actor of the musical “The Lion King” tour arrives at Angels Memorial with a throat infection, Leanne gives him a diagnosis that puts both his career and life in jeopardy. Also, the doctors and the cast of “The Lion King” help a 17-year-old boy deal with the difficult decision of taking his father off life support,

10.o: Leanne becomes rattled at the thought of losing Jesse, as he fights for his life after suffering a massive heart attack. Meanwhile, Mario asks the residents to cover for him so he can search the city for a patient’s son, which goes against Neal’s direct order not to leave the hospital

11.o: Heavy fog at the scene of a massive multi-vehicle accident puts the doctors in danger; Jesse's confidence has taken a hit; Carla's condition turns critical.

12.o: As the doctors treat patients from the chaotic multi-vehicle accident, a love triangle begins to build between Mario, Angus and Heather. Also, when Malaya learns that Carla is at the hospital, she goes against Carla's wishes and stays by her side during the delivery of her baby. Shiri Appleby guest stars.

13.o: Angus' older brother, an "all-star" ER doctor, tries to secure a position at Angels Memorial. Meanwhile, Christa's romantic feelings towards Neal begin to grow; and Malaya deals with a patient who is obsessed with her.

14.o: Leanne visits a prison to finally confront the drunk driver who killed her family. Meanwhile, Malaya begins to feel uncomfortable around her patient.

15.o: After a violent incident inside the hospital results with some grave injuries, the doctors are questioned. Christa and Neal admit their relationship to human resources.

16.o: Christa is feeling insecure after Neal's former girlfriend makes a return to the hospital after a year of volunteering in Haiti.

17.o: Christa has to try and ignore her personal feelings as she and Grace attempt to help a patient who says he was abused at a camp for troubled teenagers.

18.o: Mario confronts Angus about his Adderall abuse and Christa is surprised to learn how romantically involved Neal and Grace were before she left for Haiti. Also, Dr. Mark Taylor returns to help Leanne find the money in their budget to keep Jesse and the nurses from walking out.

1.o: The new residents are introduced to the ER. A new doctor from the army who knows many advanced procedures is flown to a shark attack on the beach with Mike Leighton and Leighton falls 20 feet from the helicopter. Dr. Guthrie Jr. is promoted to the director of the ER in addition to the OR.

2.o: Willis must help a promising soccer player make a life-altering decision after he's seriously injured, and another patient's hesitation to share that she's transgender makes it difficult for the doctors to diagnose her severe abdominal pain.

3.o: Willis defies Campbell’s orders when he helps Mario and Heather perform a radical procedure on a maintenance worker stuck under a boiler that exploded. Also, Angus’ father, Dr. Desmond Leighton, tries to seize Power of Attorney over Mike, who is still in a coma, even though Mike granted that right to his brother, Angus.

4.o: On Halloween night, Willis, Noa and Elliott rush to the scene of a fire at a haunted theater, where Dr. Nolan and her boyfriend’s son are trapped,

5.o: The Angels Memorial doctors treat victims caught in a landslide, and a group of children come in from a camping trip with measles putting the entire ER at risk.

6.o: Malaya must inform a college student who regains consciousness at Angels Memorial that she's the victim of a rape. Meanwhile, Willis and Campbell butt heads over a terminally ill woman who wants to end her life on her own terms; and a comedian is treated after he collapses on stage during a performance.

7.o: Willis and Campbell are sent to a Russian submarine in U.S. waters to treat a sailor badly wounded during an explosion, and violent convicts injured during a prison riot descend upon Angels Memorial.

8.o: The doctors treat cult members who unwillingly survived a mass suicide attempt, and Mario decides to connect with his late father’s girlfriend.

9.o: Willis, Leanne and Jesse risk their lives to operate on an injured officer who has an explosive bullet lodged in her leg. Meanwhile, Mario, Noah and Guthrie treat a magician who comes to the hospital with breathing difficulties.

10.o: A 13-year-old girl arrives at Angels Memorial following a seizure caused by spina bifida and the doctors are shocked to learn she is Campbell's daughter. Meanwhile, a workaholic deaf patient and her translator are treated after their car rolls into the Los Angeles River.

11.o: A code black at Angels Memorial takes a turn for the worse when a city- wide blackout leaves the hospital without power or back-up generators. As Campbell and Leanne divert high-risk patients to a nearby care center, Elliot and Heather are trapped in an elevator with a woman in labor, and Willis and Dr. Nolan try to help a 92-year-old woman who thinks it’s 1942.

12.o: Leanne defies Campbell's order and uses the hospital helicopter to reunite a family for the last time. Meanwhile, Willis and Loa use a cell phone app to communicate with an autistic young girl.

13.o: Guthrie becomes the hospital's new chaplain and considers undergoing a risky surgery to treat his Parkinson's. Meanwhile, the doctors treat patients involved in an apartment fire.

14.o: After pulling a double shift, Mario risks his own life when he follows Willis to a construction site where two brothers are trapped on a crane 300 feet above the ground.

15.o: The ER is quarantined when a viral outbreak jeopardizes the lives of the doctors and patients at Angels Memorial. Also, Ariel, the young girl Leanne bonded with a year ago when she lost her father, returns to Angels.

16.o: The doctors work with the Center for Disease Control and Prevention to find an antidote to the deadly viral outbreak at Angels Memorial. Also, Leanne makes a life-changing decision, and Jesse welcomes a new batch of residents.

1.o: The doctors must race to save a girl caught in the crossfire of a shoot-out; Willis shifts his focus to field medicine, choosing to work primarily on an ambulance with his new partner, paramedic Rox; Leanne begins her journey to adopt Ariel.

2.o: Angus and Mario treat a patient who is a self-proclaimed psychic and envisions the staff singing and dancing, seeing beauty amid the chaos at Angels Memorial. Also, Willis and Rox put their lives in danger to rescue a congressman and his staffer from a multi-car accident.

3.o: Jesse is in denial when his brother arrives at Angels Memorial in bad shape after being pinned down in a warehouse collapse and further tests reveal he has advanced congestive heart failure. Also, Willis opens up to Rox about his brother who was killed in Afghanistan.

4.o: Willis and Rox arrive at a road rage accident resulting in multiple serious injuries. Also, Elliot doubts his ability as a doctor when he’s sued for his role in the death of the SWAT officer involved in the drug bust-turned-shootout, and Leanne discovers Ariel on an ice cream “date” with Max, a young patient at the hospital.

5.o: Over the radio, Leanne and Jesse talk a young girl through how to use the supplies on board a small plane to build a makeshift defibrillator when her mom, the pilot, loses consciousness mid-flight. Also, Rox and Willis are taken hostage at gunpoint while on their way to meet the plane at the landing site.

6.o: Willis and Rox are called to the scene of a wildfire in the mountains of Los Angeles to tend to the injured firefighters, and they choose to stay to look for a missing young boy who was separated from his father in the chaos.

7.o: Rox decides to make amends with her former step coach when she arrives to Angels Memorial with the local high school step team after a pyramid stunt goes wrong. Also, Noa pleads with Leanne and Campbell to try any other method before performing an emergency hysterectomy on a young teenage girl, who is experiencing complications after giving birth.

8.o: Mario joins Rox and Willis on the scene of a boat crash and, in Center Stage, Leanne works to save a brother and sister who drank boiling water through a straw as part of a challenge. Also, Max's father tells Leanne to keep Ariel away from his son after he finds them kissing.

9.o: Max is brought to Angels Memorial with breathing difficulty, and Ariel tells him she loves him. Also, Rox accompanies Willis and Martin to the funeral of an army buddy of Willis' brother, and Willis decides to get to the bottom of what happened to his brother's unit.

10.o: Elliot fears the worst after hearing the emotional testimony by Detective Gomez's wife at his malpractice trial, but he hopes footage Diego shot for his documentary will change her mind. Also, Rox attempts to connect with Willis but he pushes her away, and Leanne attempts to comfort Ariel in the wake of a devastating loss.

11.o: While rescuing an injured firefighter, Rox is hit by a drunk driver and rushed to Angels Memorial. Willis begins to realize his feelings for Rox and goes to great lengths to help her. Also, Leanne is excited to tell Ariel good news about her adoption.

12.t: As Night Comes and I'm Breathing
12.o: Willis continues to tend to Rox's medical needs in San Diego and Leanne and Max's father go searching for Ariel. Also, when Noa reveals to Mario she wants to take a job offer in Philadelphia, and Campbell offers Mario the attending position at Angels, they realize their career choices will mean ending their relationship.

13.o: Angels Memorial descends into chaos when a plane crashes into the 8th floor. Also, Noa has a car accident and it is up to Mario to save her life. Also, Willis admits to Rox that he needs her in his life and the doctors gather in court to support Leanne for her custody hearing.

11.t: Let's Keep Going, Lord Beerus! The Battle of Gods!

12.t: The Universe Will Shatter? Clash! Destroyer vs. Super Saiyan God!
12.o: The destructive power of Goku and Beerus' fight puts the entire universe in danger.

13.o: Although Goku loses the Super Saiyan God form, he absorbs and retains its power, and continues to fight Beerus.

14.t: This Is All the Power I've Got! A Settlement Between Gods
14.o: The fight between Goku and Beerus reaches its climactic end.

15.t: Valiant Mr. Satan, Work a Miracle! A Challenge from Outer Space!

16.t: Vegeta Becomes a Student?! Win Over Whis!

17.o: Some time has passed on Earth. Gohan and Videl’s daughter is finally born!!

18.o: Goku departs Earth and begins training under Whis. The surprising training method is…!?

24.t: Clash! Frieza vs. Goku; This Is the Result of My Training!

26.t: A Chance Appears in a Tight Spot! Launch a Counteroffensive, Goku!

28.t: The 6th Universe's Destroyer! His Name Is Champa!
28.o: While training on Beerus' Planet, Goku and Vegeta meet Beerus' twin brother Champa.

29.t: Combat Matches Are a Go! The Captain Is Someone Stronger Than Goku

30.t: A Run-Through For the Competition! Who Are the Last Two Members?
30.o: Goku and Vegeta go find the two remaining members for Team Universe 7.

31.t: Off to See Master Zuno! Find Out Where the Super Dragon Balls Are!
31.o: Jaco and Bulma visit Zuno to learn more about the Super Dragon Balls.

32.t: The Matches Begin! We're All Off to the "Planet with No Name!"
32.o: The tournament between Universe 6 and Universe 7 begins! The first match is going underway.

33.t: Surprise, 6th Universe! This is Super Saiyan Goku!
33.o: It's Goku versus Botamo! After Goku's victory, he faces Frost, Universe 6's version of Frieza. Who wins the match...?

34.t: Piccolo vs. Frost! Stake It All on the Special Beam Cannon!
34.o: The next contestant for Team Universe 7 is Piccolo. Frost is doing what?!

35.t: Turn Your Anger into Strength! Vegeta's Full-Bore Battle
35.o: Vegeta battles Frost. After a short-lived fight, Vegeta is challenged by Magetta.

36.t: An Unexpectedly Uphill Battle! Vegeta's Great Blast of Fury!
36.o: Vegeta is struggling during his match with Magetta. What is Magetta doing to Vegeta?!

37.t: Don't Forget Your Saiyan Pride! Vegeta vs. the 6th Universe's Saiyan
37.o: The next match is between Vegeta and the Saiyan from Universe 6, Cabba. What secret power does Cabba possess?

38.t: The 6th Universe's Mightiest Warrior! Engage the Assassin Hit!
38.o: The final contestant for Universe 6 is the confident, legendary assassin, Hit. Does Vegeta stand a chance?

39.t: A Developed "Time Skip" Counterstrike? Here Comes Goku's New Move!
39.o: The battle between Goku and Hit continues, however, Hit proves to be more formidable than anticipated.

40.t: A Decision at Last! Is the Winner Beerus? Or Is it Champa?
40.o: The winner of the tournament between Universe 6 and 7 is decided!

41.t: Come Forth, Divine Dragon! And Grant My Wish, Peas and Carrots!
41.o: As the winners of the Tournament Universe 7 are given the Super Dragon Balls and make summon the Dragon for their wish.

42.t: A Chaotic Victory Party! Showdown at Last?! Monaka vs. Goku!
42.o: The Tournament may be over, but Goku still wants to battle Monaku to see how really strong he is. While Beers and the rest of Dragon Ball Cast try and keep his secret hidden from Goku.

43.t: Goku's Energy Is Out of Control?! The Struggle to Look After Pan
43.o: Pan is kidnapped thought to be defenseless by her captors, but as it turned out, the plan backfired.

44.t: The Seal of Planet Pot-au-feu; Secrets of the Unleashed Superhuman Water!
44.o: While Monaka delivers super sweets of the Galaxy to Bulma, Trunks and Goten end up locking themselves in his truck. Finding trouble on a planet Pot-au-feu, Where Vegeta and Jaco have to go and rescue them.

45.t: Vegeta Disappears?! Menace of the Duplicate Vegeta!
45.o: With Vegeta losing all of his power to the copy of himself that was made from Superhuman Water, it is up to Goten and Trunks to defeat him. Mean while Goku is back at full health and training at Kaio's planet.

46.t: Goku vs. the Duplicate Vegeta! Which One Is Going to Win?
46.o: The battle between Goku and Duplicate Vegeta Continues. Will Goku defeat the copy in time to save Vegeta?

47.t: SOS from the Future: A Dark New Enemy Appears!
47.o: In the timeline of Future Trunks, a new enemy appears that requires him to return to the past and get help from the Z-Fighters.

48.t: Hope!! Redux: Awaken in the Present, Trunks
48.o: Much to everyone's surprise, a war-torn and unconscious Future Trunks arrives in the past after evading Black.

49.t: A Message from the Future - The Incursion of Goku Black!
49.o: After awakening in the present, Future Trunks mistakes Goku for his evil look-alike Black.

50.t: Goku vs. Black! A Closed-Off Road to the Future
50.o: Goku Black invades from Trunks' future! Excited to fight a strong opponent, Goku immediately challenges him to one-on-one combat, but Goku Black isn't taking the fight seriously?!

51.t: Feelings That Transcend Time: Trunks and Mai
51.o: Bulma finds the Time Machine that Cell used to travel to the past and promptly gathers the team to repair it. Future Trunks and Mai discuss their counterparts from alternate timelines.

52.t: Master and Pupil Reunited! Gohan and "Future" Trunks!
52.o: Piccolo mentions that Gohan decided to abandon his training to become a scholar, which suprised Future Trunks. Piccolo and Kuririn suggest that Future Trunks should meet their timeline's Gohan.

53.t: Uncover Black's Identity! Off to the 10th Universe's World of the Kai's!
53.o: Goku, Beerus, and Whis arrive in Universe Ten. They meet the Supreme Kai Gowasu and his apprentice Zamasu.

54.t: He Who Is of Saiyan Blood: Trunks's Resolve
54.o: Vegeta wants to test Future Trunks' power to see how strong his son had become.

55.t: I'd Like to See Goku, You See; A Summons From Grand Zeno!
55.o: Whis and Beerus are worried over Zen-Oh's request to meet Goku and what it could mean for their universe.

56.t: Rematch with Goku Black! Enter Super Saiyan Rosé
56.o: Goku and Vegeta appear in the future to fight Goku Black, but they find that he has developed a new power.

57.t: A God with an Invincible Body - The Advent of Zamasu
57.o: Zamasu appears unexpectedly from the sky. He states that he and Goku Black are "kindred spirits" who want a world without mortals.

58.t: Zamasu and Black - The Duo's Mystery Deepens
58.o: Defeated, Son Goku, Vegeta and Trunks travel to the present, in order to find a way to defeat Zamasu. We also witness a developing relating to the mystery between Black and Zamasu.

59.t: Protect the Supreme Kai Gowasu - Destroy Zamasu!
59.o: Goku, Beerus and Whis must save Gowasu from his treacherous apprentice.

60.t: Into the Future Again - Goku Black's True Identity Revealed!
60.o: Trunks returns to the future, with Goku and his parents accompanying him. There they discover Goku Black still lives, and he explains how he defied space and time to exist.

61.t: Zamasu's Ambition – The Storied "Project 0 Mortals" of Terror
61.o: Goku, Vegeta and Future Trunks fight Black and Zamasu in the future. Black explains his true identity.

62.t: I Will Defend the World! Trunks' Furious Burst of Super Power!
62.o: With his new found power, Trunks attempts to hold off Black and Zamasu. Meanwhile, Goku and Vegeta head back to the past to try come up with a new strategy.

63.t: Don't You Disgrace Saiyan Cells! Vegeta's Fierce Battle Commences!
63.o: Trunks wakes up in a rebel base only to find out that Mai set off on her own in an attempt to take out Black. Will he make it in time to save her?

64.t: Worship Me! Give Praise Unto Me! The Explosive Birth of a Merged Zamasu!
64.o: As the battle rages on in the future, Bulma and Trunks devise a plan to take down Zamasu, meanwhile, Vegeta shows his new-found strength while taking on Goku Black.

65.t: Final Judgement? The Ultimate Power of an Absolute God
65.o: The two zamasu fuse and become the ultimate god. Meanwhile Vegeta, Goku and others are stunned and try to somehow defeat the eternal god.

66.t: Showdown! The Miraculous Power of Unyielding Warriors
66.o: After Goku's attack shakes Zamazu's balance and reveal a weakness in him, he and Vegeta fuse together as they see hope to prevail. Nevertheless, It's Trunks's world and to him it all ultimately comes down.

67.t: With New Hope in His Heart - Farewell, Trunks
67.o: Zamasu makes one final almighty move to destroy the universe, but Goku brings out a forgotten but all-powerful ally to stop him.

68.t: Come Forth, Shenron! Whose Wish Will Be Granted?
68.o: Goku decides to summon Shenron to honor a promise, but his friends have things they want to wish for too.

69.t: Goku vs. Arale! An Off-the-Wall Battle Spells the End of the Earth?
69.o: Goku and the android girl Arale Norimaki meet after many years, in a fun-filled episode where the cast of Dr Slump and DBZ meet.

70.t: A Challenge from Champa! This Time, a Baseball Game!
70.o: Chanpa returns, and offers a baseball game between him and Beerus.

71.t: Goku Dies! An Assassination That Must Be Executed!
71.o: Hit gets a contract to kill Goku, and prepares his assassination.

72.t: Will He Strike Back? The Unseen Killing Technique!
72.o: Goku manages to come back to life, but he seeks a fight with Hit. And who is the client who put Hit to fight Goku?

73.t: Gohan's Plight! The Preposterous Great Saiyaman Film Adaptation?!
73.o: A film of the Great Saiyaman is to be made, and Gohan is to be in it - to his chagrin, as a stuntman.

74.t: For My Beloved Ones! The Indomitable Great Saiyaman!
74.o: Barry Kahn's attempts to sabotage Gohan get lethal when the alien parasite Watagash takes control of him.

75.t: Goku and Krillin! Back to the Old Familiar Training Ground!
75.o: Krillin decides to train with Goku after a police battle goes bad, but can he match up to the Saiyan's level?

76.t: Conquer the Terrifying Foes! Krillin's Fighting Spirit Rebounds!
76.o: Goku and Krillin fight against their old enemies such as Frieza and Cell in a form of nightmares in a mystical forest Master Roshi sent them to in order to fetch him a special herb.

77.t: Let's Do It, Grand Zeno! The Universes' Best Tournament!!
77.o: Goku goes and sees Zen-O to get the Tournament of Power going.

78.t: Even the Universes' Gods are Appalled?! The Lose-and-Perish Tournament of Power

79.t: The 9th Universe's Kicking Basil vs. the 7th Universe's Majin Buu!!
79.o: Majin Buu and Basil the Kicker continue to give Zen-Chan a show while they unravel the fight.

1.o: Woo Seung and Ji Hoon both have separate dreams. Woo Seung is working hard to become a civil servant, and Ji Hoon hopes to become a celebrity. Woo Seung struggles financially, and works while she studies. Ji Hoon is hiding the fact that he’s a trainee, and works hard to achieve his goal.

2.o: Hyun Jae ends up in the year 2017 due to a hurricane that occurred in 1993. Best friends Woo Seung and Ji Hoon meet each other by chance in the police station due to two separate incidents. As they are leaving the police station, they accidentally hit Hyun Jae who came out of nowhere.

3.o: Hyun Jae almost gets hit by Woo Seung, Ji Hoon, and MC Drill’s car and faints. He finds himself in a hospital in the year 2017 and has a hard time accepting the reality. Woo Seung moves out of Eun Ah’s home and into Ji Hoon’s place. Meanwhile, a twist of fate brings Woo Seung and Hyun Jae together.

4.o: Hyun Jae and Woo Seung end up in an unknown place outside of Seoul. On their way back, they stop at a rest stop where Hyun Jae sees Gwang Jae. In the heat of the moment, he leaves Woo Seung and chases after Gwang Jae. Woo Seung vows to get revenge on Hyun Jae for stealing her things and leaving her.

5.o: Hyun Jae tells Ji Hoon, Woo Seung, and MC Drill that he lost his memory due to the car accident. Therefore, he ends up staying with them. While everyone is out of the house, he stays home, and almost bumps into Bo Hee.

6.o: The day of Woo Seung’s test and Ji Hoon and MC Drill’s assessment has finally come. Everyone is nervous and hopes for the best results. Ji Hoon’s family all think that he’s going to take the civil service exam, and wishes him luck. Meanwhile, Ji Hoon and Hyun Jae wish Woo Seung luck on her exam.

7.o: Ji Hoon, Woo Seung, and MC Drill are all disappointed with their results, but they refuse to give up on their dreams. Bo Hee finally gets an opportunity to go on a TV show and decides to show off her talents to please the audience. Hyun Jae asks Woo Seung to take him to the place where his car was found.

8.o: On their way home from the lake, Hyun Jae hears his unreleased song and finds out it’s MJ’s song. Woo Seung is late for her part-time job and brings Hyun Jae with her. While at the convenience store, Hyun Jae bumps into MJ and asks him about the song.

9.o: Gwang Jae and Hyun Jae meet, and Gwang Jae tries to figure out what the truth is. In her drunken state, Bo Hee thinks she had a dream of Hyun Jae, and tells Gwang Jae. Gwang Jae is nervous that the family will find out the truth and tries to help Hyun Jae return to the past.

10.o: Woo Seung gets fired from another job and decides to have a party with Hyun Jae, Ji Hoon, and MC Drill. Woo Seung gets drunk and surprises the gang. While shopping, Hyun Jae finds out they’re having a singing contest and enters into. Meanwhile, Ji Hoon accuses Hyun Jae of stealing his watch.

11.o: Hyun Jae is shocked to find out that Ji Hoon is his son. Hyun Jae attempts to show up in front of Bo Hee, but Gwang Jae stops him. Gwang Jae is worried that Bo Hee might get hurt again, so he gives Hyun Jae a cellphone and tells him to call him if he needs something.

12.o: Gwang Jae’s birthday is also the day that Hyun Jae disappeared. Soon Tae tells Bo Hee to cook dinner to celebrate Gwang Jae’s birthday and not Hyun Jae’s death. Bo Hee spends the day preparing food, and Soon Tae and Mal Sook wonder who the meal is for. Meanwhile, Hyun Jae is stuck inside the house because Ji Hoon gave Gwang Jae the wrong gift.

13.o: Gwang Jae finds out that Ji Hoon is a trainee. He is angry and storms up to the loft to confront Ji Hoon. When he gets there, he finds out that aside from Hyun Jae, Woo Seung and MC Drill have all been living there. Gwang Jae tells Hyun Jae that everything is his fault and that he should leave. Hyun Jae tells Gwang Jae that he won’t leave until he finds the missing 2 million dollars.

14.o: Bo Hee gets casted for a commercial, and she and Gwang Jae go for a meeting. Woo Seung goes to Star Punch Entertainment for an interview, and meets MJ again. Gwang Jae swallows his pride and goes to Young Jae to borrow money to pay off his bank loan. Meanwhile, Hyun Jae tries to figure out the truth behind his disappearance and the whereabouts of the 2 million dollars.

15.o: Woo Seung and Hyun Jae bump into Ji Hoon and Hye Ri at the restaurant. Woo Seung thinks that Ji Hoon and Hye Ri are dating. Ji Hoon tells her they’re not and that he likes another person. Meanwhile, Hyun Jae and Gwang Jae uses the notes written in his composition notebook to find clues as to where the missing money is.

16.o: Hyun Jae tries to figure out the passcode to Woo Seung’s room. He also begins working at the bakery and as a manager for World Entertainment. Bo Hee goes to shoot her commercial and sees an unwelcomed friend from the past. Gwang Jae encourages Ji Hoon to take action for the things that he wants and Ji Hoon decides to tell Woo Seung his feelings.

17.o: Hyun Jae, a self-proclaimed dating master, decides to give Ji Hoon some tips on how to win Woo Seung’s favor. Ji Hoon pretends to be uninterested, but he takes mental notes and tries them out on Woo Seung. Meanwhile, Ji Hoon quits being a trainee and works at the bakery. His photograph is taken, and it goes viral on social media. As a result, Star Punch Entertainment calls him.

18.o: Soon Tae keeps telling Gwang Jae to apologize to Young Jae, but he refuses. Bo Hee overhears their conversation and meets with Young Jae. Meanwhile, Woo Seung goes hiking with her co-workers and hurts her leg. She calls Hyun Jae for help, but Hyun Jae decides that this is Ji Hoon’s perfect chance. However, Ji Hoon has his phone off and doesn’t get the text message.

19.o: Hyun Jae is surprised by the feelings he has developed for Woo Seung. Ji Hoon catches Hyun Jae looking at Woo Seung and asks him if he is interested in her. Hyun Jae finds out that Gwang Jae is about to lose World Villa because he can’t repay the bank loan. As a result, Hyun Jae decides that he must meet Young Jae.

20.o: Hyun Jae decides to pay Young Jae a visit to help Gwang Jae. When they meet, Hyun Jae makes a deal with Young Jae. In return for Hyun Jae keeping the composition notebook a secret, Young Jae must pay Gwang Jae’s debt and give Hyun Jae a job. Meanwhile, we learn the truth about why Mal Sook lives with Soon Tae, and what had happened to her mother.

21.o: Hye Ri introduces Ji Hoon to a different agency, and he auditions for them. Meanwhile, Hyun Jae keeps an eye on Woo Seung and MJ. He doesn't like the way MJ treats her, and decides to use his newfound position to help her out. He manages to take her out of the office, and the two of them spend the day together.

22.o: Ji Hoon hears back from the agency he auditioned for and finds out that he has been accepted. Ji Hoon and Gwang Jae go fishing together and have a heart to heart. That same day, MC Drill must go to reserved forces training. Hyun Jae goes to pick Woo Seung up when it starts raining, and with Ji Hoon and MC Drill out of the house for the night, Woo Seung and Hyun Jae are left alone in the loft.

23.o: After Woo Seung and Hyun Jae's night alone in the loft, the two people begin to have feelings for one another. Ji Hoon find's Hyun Jae's watch and realizes that it is exactly the same as the watch his father had left him. Hyun Jae decides to tell Ji Hoon that he likes Woo Seung. Meanwhile, Gwang Jae decides that he wants to try to rebuild World Entertainment.

24.o: Hyun Jae is troubled with Ji Hoon’s request that he stop his feelings for Woo Seung. As a result, Hyun Jae tries to keep his distance from Woo Seung. Meanwhile, Gwang Jae continues to make a business plan for the renewal of World Entertainment, and Hyun Jae finds out the meaning behind the number 22198.

25.o: Gwang Jae tells Ji Hoon that Da Bong is Hyun Jae, who is his biological father. Upon hearing this, Ji Hoon says that he only has one father, and that father is Gwang Jae. Meanwhile, Young Jae finds out that Gwang Jae is trying to rebuild World Entertainment.

26.o: Gwang Jae continues in his preparations for the relaunch of World Entertainment, and Hyun Jae finishes the song he has written for Ji Hoon. Ji Hoon finds out about all the secrets Drill has been keeping from him. Woo Seung decides moves out of the loft and rents a place nearby. Meanwhile, Young Jae steals Gwang Jae's investors and even the song Hyun Jae wrote for Ji Hoon.

27.o: Woo Seung finds out that Da Bong is the same Yoo Hyun Jae that disappeared 20 years ago. She is conflicted by the news and tries her best to avoid him. Ji Hoon and Hyun Jae go camping, and Hyun Jae apologizes for letting him grow up without a father.

28.o: Gwang Jae finds out that his investors backed out and goes to them to convince them otherwise. Ji Hoon and Hyun Jae have a heart-to-heart while camping, and get to know each other a bit better. Hyun Jae finds a safety deposit box key, and goes to the bank it’s from. Meanwhile, MJ continues to ask Hyun Jae to teach him how to write songs.

29.o: After leaving the loft, Hyun Jae is stuck without a place to go. Woo Seung opens up her home, and the two of them enjoy each other’s company. One day, Soon Tae says he has an appointment and leaves the house. On his way back, he loses his memory and gets lost.

30.o: Young Jae tells Hyun Jae that in 1994 he saw him with an unidentified man by the lake where he disappeared. Hyun Jae tries to piece the puzzle together in order to figure out how and why he disappeared when he hears news of a coming storm. He struggles with the notion of returning and comes to a conclusion.

31.o: Hyun Jae returns to the past. However, he doesn’t return to 1993. Rather, he returns to the period right before he disappears in 1994. Ji Hoon and Drill finally debut. While they are waiting for their turn, they bump into Hye Ri. Meanwhile, Woo Seung begins working at World Entertainment.

32.o: While working at World Entertainment, Woo Seung decides that she wants to study composing music. Gwang Jae and Bo Hee get married. Before their wedding, Gwang Jae decides to propose to her by putting a ring in her ice cream. Hyun Jae returns to 2017 and goes to Woo Seung.

1.o: The events revolve around a man and a woman falling in love with each other, and while they agree to get married, they find everyone around them rejecting this idea, so why are those around them rejected, and will they get married, or what will happen?

The series is about a girl named Momo who attends high school at the city of Sorasaki. However, she is secretly a member of Tsukikage, an intelligence agency that protects people. As a new member of the agency, she works alongside her colleagues including her senior Yuki and friends. Together, they work to establish peace in the city.

2.o: It’s one thing to WANT to join a secret intelligence organization, but a completely different matter to pass initiation! Good luck, Momo, you’re gonna need it!

3.o: All Momo wants is Yuki’s approval, but her mistakes nearly botch Tsukikage’s missions! Is she really cut out for this role or will experience come with time?

4.o: As an apprentice, Fu owes a lot to Tsukikage, especially to Mei. How far is Fu willing push herself and what can Mei do about it?

5.o: Momo’s dedication to the cause negatively impacts her personal life. Meanwhile, the Moryo organization establishes a new affiliate to lure Tsukikage out into the open.

6.o: Humanity can be cruel. Two friends were torn apart and forced down divergent paths. One joined Tsukikage, and the other joined Moryo. What happens when they reunite?

7.o: Theresia continues her investigation into Hatsume’s ties to Tsukikage. Hatsume attempts to rekindle her old friendship with the Moryo agent but where will this leave Goe?

8.o: Tsukikage travels to Okinawa and discovers that their contact, The Shisa, have been wiped out by the Nirai Kanai. Meanwhile, Goe bonds with a girl claiming to be a Viking.

9.o: All members of Tsukikage had mentors at some point. Yuki tells Momo the story of her own mentor, a girl known as Nagaho. Whatever happened to her?

10.o: All things must end, and that includes Moryo's reign of terror. The countdown begins while Tsukikage has a heart-to-heart. They prepare to take down Moryo once and for all.

11.o: It was a trap! With the traitor revealed and Tsukikage decimated, Moryo’s ambitions now stand unopposed. However, it is always the darkest before the dawn...

12.o: Project Gekkako is now up and running. With only a few remaining members of Tsukikage left, will they be able to save everyone or fail as others before them?

2.o: While settling into life as a 26-year-old, Liza looks to date someone age-appropriate, and learn to market to a younger audience.

14.o: تشك الأبلة دلال بكل من حولها. تتجنب الفتيات في المدرسة الاختلاط بسارة، التي تصل لاحقا إلى حفل زفاف إياد في محاولة يائسة للتحدث إليه.

15.o: بعد معرفة بشاير بمشاعر سارة تجاه إياد، تتوتر علاقة الصديقتين. يختفي الهاتف الذي عثرت عليه أم عادل. يستهدف فيديو مسرب شروق.

16.o: تتعرض فاطمة لاعتداء يفقدها الوعي. تتلقى سارة درسا عن الحب الحقيقي من والدتها. يقرر والد ندى تأجيل زواجه.

17.o: تقرر أم عادل تحمل اللوم عن ابنتها. تحاول سارة تصحيح الأمور مع بشاير. تركز ندى على الشفاء من تجربتها المؤلمة.

18.o: تبدأ ندى ووالدتها صفحة جديدة. تحكي نارت قصتها الكاملة للفتيات. تتخذ الأبلة دلال الإجراء اللازم بحق صاحبة الحساب.

1.o: بعد أن تلحق البنات الأذى بحبيبها خلال العطلة الصيفية، تعزم سافانا على الانتقام له، فتنضم إلى مدرستهن كجزء من خطتها الشيطانية ضدهن.

2.o: بينما تكافح إدارة المدرسة للحفاظ على سمعتها، تنتقل سافانا إلى المرحلة التالية من خطتها: إقناع رهف بالتمرد على تقاليد عائلتها.

3.o: يحين موعد التجارب التي انتظرتها بشاير طويلا، لكن تبيت سافانا ضدها مكيدة جديدة. تبدأ العنود التحقيق في حادثة نهى في المدرسة. يسير أول حديث بين فاطمة والشاب التي تعجب به بطريقة لم تكن تتوقعها.

4.o: تزداد رغبة سافانا في الانتقام وتقرر جعل فاطمة فريستها التالية. أما ندى، فتجري تحقيقها الخاص. تحاول البنات مساعدة رهف على العودة إلى المدرسة.

5.o: تتغيب فاطمة وسافانا عن المدرسة للذهاب إلى المستشفى. تتوتر صداقة سارة وبشاير. توجه العنود إنذارا نهائيا لرهف.

6.o: تعكر فضيحة جديدة صفو احتفال المدرسة باليوم الوطني السعودي. تتفاقم عوارض فاطمة. تقضي بشاير وقتا ممتعا مع عمر.

7.o: تتردد فاطمة تجاه عبد الرحمن أثناء إحيائه حفلا غنائيا. تحاول معلمة بشاير إقناع فوزية بمنحها فرصة ثانية. توضع رهف في موقف صعب بسبب والدها.

8.o: تجد والدة فاطمة دواءها، لكن شخصا غير متوقع ينقذها من العقاب. تجد العنود خيوطا جديدة في القضية. تأخذ حفلة سارة الأولى منعطفا نحو الأسوأ.

9.o: تحاول سافانا التقرب من ندى ووالدتها. تؤدي أعراض انسحاب المسكن إلى تغيير في سلوك فاطمة. تواجه العنود سافانا بشأن عقد إيجارها المزور.

10.o: تقتاد فاطمة إلى مركز الشرطة بعد أن تنصب لها سافانا فخا. تقدم فوزية عرضا لبشاير. تتدخل سافانا بين ندى ووالدتها.

11.o: مصممة على المضي قدما بخطتها، تبتز سافانا صديقتها بيان. تحذر سارة فاطمة من سافانا. تنتشر الشائعات حول ندى بين زميلاتها في المدرسة.

12.o: يدعو زياد ندى إلى البودكاست الخاص به حيث يتحدثان عن الثقة. تشك فوزية في نوايا العنود. تنتهي مكالمة هاتفية بين فاطمة وعبد الرحمن بمأساة.

13.o: تجد فاطمة نفسها في مأزق بعد اعتراف عبد الرحمن بمشاعره لها. تواجه رهف زياد بشأن تصرفاته الغريبة. يزداد موقف سارة صعوبة بعد تهديدات سافانا.

14.o: تستعيد بشاير قوتها وتستعد لإبهار لجنة التحكيم. أما ندى، فتصلها رسالة من مجهول تشوش ذهنها. تضحي فاطمة بصداقتها مع سارة من أجل الحفاظ على سرها.

15.o: يتغلب خوف بشاير عليها أثناء التجارب. يحاول إياد مصالحة زوجته. تصل ندى إلى طرف خيط قد يكشف ماضي سافانا.

16.o: تنقل فاطمة على عجل إلى المستشفى بعد إغمائها في الحمام. تتمكن ندى وبشاير من التغيب عن المدرسة للتحري عن سافانا. في هذه الأثناء، تدفع سافانا سارة إلى حافة الهاوية.

17.o: تضع ندى حدودا واضحة مع زياد. تطلب بشاير المساعدة من عمر بعد تعرضها لحادث سيارة مع البنات. تقترب سافانا من اكتشاف سر فاطمة.

18.o: تحاول البنات معرفة الدوافع وراء تصرفات سافانا. على أمل التخلص من دينها، تبدأ سارة في استقبال مواعيد للتاتو.

19.o: بعد أن تتفق ندى مع سارة على التحري عن تركي، سرعان ما تجد الأخيرة نفسها في مأزق مع احتمال انكشاف سرها. أما سافانا، فتضع خطة للتخلص من البنات إلى الأبد.

20.o: الحلقة الأخيرة: تجمع سافانا البنات في مكان اجتماعهن المعتاد لمواجهة نهائية، حيث تكشف كل الأسرار والنيات الخفية.

1.o: تضع نادرة مولودًا جديدًا. يقرر عبدالجبار قرارًا يخلق أحقادًا دفينة بين أبناءه بسبب نظرتهم المستقبلية الطامعة في الميراث، ونتيجة لذلك يحاول مسعود وعلاء التخلص من أخيهما بلال.

2.o: يقتل مسعود - بلال، ويتقدم عصام للزواج من أُنس، لكن عبدالجبار يماطل في الموافقة بسبب خصومة مع أسرة عصام، وتشيع جنازة بلال، وتتصاعد الخلافات في بيت عبدالجبار بعد اكتشافهم قرارًا مصيريًا أخفاه بلال قبل وفاته.

3.o: يقرر عبد الجبار تزويج نادرة لمسعود أو علاء بعد اكتشافهم أن بلال قد كتب الأرض التي يمتلكها باسمها، لكن نادرة تواجه هذا القرار بقرار آخر يجعل الأمور أكثر تعقيدا في بيت عبدالجبار.

4.o: تحاول سميرة تسميم نادرة بعد موافقتها على الزواج من مسعود لكن الأخيرة تكتشف الأمر، ثم ترفض الزواج من مسعود، بينما تتصاعد الخلافات بين عائلة حسن وعبدالجبار بسبب تجارة السلاح.

5.o: تختفي نادرة من منزل عبدالجبار ولا تترك أثرا لها، فيحاول عبدالجبار جاهدا البحث عنها ويتهم عائلة أبو عصاية بخطفها هي وابنها فتدب أحداث عنيفة في النجع، بينما تواصل نادرة رحلة الهرب والاختباء من مكان لآخر.

6.o: يعثر أفراد عائلة أبو عصاية على نادرة. ثم يهدد عبدالجبار سكان القرية بحرقها ما لم يعثروا على نادرة وابنها. وبحلول الليل، ينفذ وعده ويحرق القرية، ثم تستغل أطراف أخرى الفرصة وتصبح القرية في حالة فوضى عارمة.

7.o: تعود نادرة إلى بيت عبدالجبار وتهدأ الأوضاع في القرية، لكنها تتأزم بين أفراد عائلة عبدالجبار ويأخذون يوسف من نادرة. بينما تنشأ علاقة إعجاب متبادل بين مسعود ودميانة، ويكتشف عبدالجبار أن أُنس على علاقة بعصام.

8.o: يهدأ الخلاف بين عبدالجبار وحسن بعد الاحتكام عند المنزلاوي، ويتفقا على قطع علاقة عصام بأًنس. تظل نادرة منبوذة في المنزل بعيدا عن يوسف ثم تحاول تحسين علاقتها بسميرة.

9.o: تقوم أًنس بتهريب عبيدة بعد أن كان محتجزا عند عبدالجبار فتدخل معه في خلاف يصل للضرب، ثم تقطع علاقتها بعصام. يعود يوسف إلى حضن نادرة. بينما تتسابق عائلة عبدالجبار وعائلة أبو عصاية للوصول إلى مقبرة فرعونية مليئة بالآثار.

10.o: يتنافس عبدالجبار وأبناؤه وأفراد عائلة أبي عصاية للفوز بانتخابات مجلس الشعب. تنشأ علاقة إعجاب بين أُنس وعبيدة. يكتشف مسعود مقابلة نادرة لأخيها نبيل سرًا فيتهمها أمام العائلة بأنها تقابل عشيقها فتتهمه بقتل بلال.

11.o: تُبرز نادرة أمام عائلة عبدالجبار تقرير الطبيب الشرعي الذي يؤكد اتهمامها بقتل مسعود لبلال. يحاول شداد التقرب من نادرة. يتسلل مسعود إلى منزل دميانة لكن يكتشف عمر أمرهما. بينما تتسع الفجوة بين أفراد عائلة أبو عصاية.

12.o: تلتقي نادرة بشداد في منزل دميانة وتتفق معه على الهرب. يستعد جميع سكان النجع لليلة المولد ثم يتحول الأمر إلى فوضى وصراع بين عدة أطراف، بينما تستغل نادرة الموقف وتهرب مع نبيل.

13.o: تقع نادرة ونبيل في قبضة مسعود قبل هربهما، ثم يأمر عبدالجبار بأخذ ابنها يوسف ويتم حبسها مع نبيل، ثم يساومها بين التنازل عن الأرض مقابل حريتها، لكن تدب بينهما مشاجرة يَقتُل فيها مسعود - نبيل.

14.o: يدفن عبدالجبار ومسعود - نبيل في الصحراء، ثم يواصلان الضغط على نادرة حتى تتنازل عن ملكية الأرض. تضع إسراء مولودة. ثم تعود نادرة للمنزل وتذهب مع الجبار إلى الشهر العقاري بعد خداعها بأن نبيل حي يرزق.

15.o: يتدخل شداد وينقذ نادرة قبل توقيع قرار التنازل عن اﻷرض، فيتهم حسن أبو عصاية بتدبير اﻷمر. ثم تحاول نادرة البحث عن نبيل. بينما تكتشف سميرة بأن مسعود يقابل دميانة.

16.o: يقرر عبدالجبار الانتقام من حسن أبو عصاية، لكن يتدخل الشيخ المنزلاوي ويهدئ الأجواء المشحونة بالتوتر بينهما، ثم تتعاون العائلتان للبحث عن نادرة. بينما تصل جثة ميلاد زوج دميانة من العراق.

17.o: تتزوج نادرة من شداد، مما يثير الأمر غضبا داخل منزل عبدالجبار. تهدد نفيسة - إسراء بفيديو جنسي مصور لها مع رجل غريب وتطلب مبلغا كبيرا مقابل التكتم عن الأمر. بينما تكتشف نادرة قبر نبيل وتقرر الأخذ بثأره.

18.o: تتوتر الأجواء بين أفراد عائلة أبو عصاية بسبب اقتراب الانتخابات ويقرر حسن ترشيح نفسه أمام عبدالجبار، ثم يقرر حمزة ترشيح نفسه فيها. بينما تبذل نادرة جهدها لمنع عبدالجبار من الفوز، ثم يفوز حسن أبو عصاية في الانتخابات.

19.o: يعرض عزت الزواج على دميانة لكنها ترفض. تلجأ إسراء لنادرة لتساعدها على التخلص من نفيسة فيقوم شداد بالمهمة. ثم يبعث عبدالجبار رجاله لاختطاف نادرة ويوسف، لكنها تذهب مع شداد ورجاله ويسرقون أسلحة عبدالجبار.

20.o: يعلن عبدالجبار الحرب على نادرة وشداد. يخطط أفراد عائلة أبو عصاية لفتح مقبرة أثرية.تقرر أنس السفر لتحضير الدكتوراة لكن ترفض سكينة. بينما يُقتل شداد بعد هجوم مباغت من قبل مجهولين، ثم يطرد وهبة - نادرة من الجبل.

21.o: يعقد وهبة صلحًا مع عبدالجبار ويصبح أحد رجاله. ثم يبدأ السباق بين عبدالجبار وحسن أبو عصاية للاستيلاء على المقبرة الأثرية. ويختطف مسعود - يوسف في غفلة من نادرة.

22.o: تقرر نادرة الانتقام من مسعود وتحاول استعادة يوسف من قبضة عائلة عبدالجبار، ثم تطلب الحماية والمساعدة من حسن أبو عصاية. يتزوج عزت من دميانة، ثم تقوم ببيع منزلها لعبدالجبار تحت التهديد.

23.o: تستعين نادرة بإسراء للانتقام من مسعود، ثم يصاب بحالة ذهنية أقرب للجنون. ثم تبعث نادرة رسالة تهديد لعبدالجبار فيتشكي حسن للمنزلاوي بشأن استضافته لنادرة، لكن حسن يخبرهما بأنه تزوج منها.

24.o: يطلب حسن من عبدالجبار عودة يوسف لحضن نادرة لكنه يرفض، ثم يعترف لعطية وعصام أن زواجه من نادرة مجرد كذبة. يعترف مسعود لسكينة بقتله بلال. يبعث عبدالحق رسالة لعلاء ويهدده بإشاعة حقيقة نسب ابنته. بينما تواصل نادرة تخطيطها للانتقام من عائلة عبدالجبار.

25.o: تحرق نادرة مقر عمل عبدالجبار. يسلم علاء - عبدالحق المال الذي طلبه مقابل التكتم على فضيحة إسراء، ثم تهرب من منزله وتنتحر بعد مصارحته بحقيقة نسب ابنتها. بينما يحاول عبدالجبار الانتقام من نادرة عن طريق دميانة.

26.o: تبدأ نادرة وعبيدة حشد أهالي النجع لافتتاح مشروع تجاري يخصهم لمنافسة تجارة عبدالجبار. يظهر طلبة ويطلب من عادل المال الذي اتفقا عليه مقابل قتله حسن. ثم يبعث عبدالجبار رجاله لتخريب المشروع التجاري ﻷهل النجع.

27.o: يبدأ عبدالجبار التضييق على سكان النجع، ثم تحاول نادرة حشدهم ضده، ويحاولون إيقافه بعد بدءه عملية حفر المقبرة الأثرية. بينما تتواصل اللقاءات بين أنس وعبيدة في السر.

28.o: يطلب حسن من عبدالجبار استعادة يوسف لنادرة، لكن يُحرض عبدالجبار رجاله لاغتيال نادرة وحسن، ثم يقرر عطية الانتقام منه. يفقد مسعود عقله تماما. بينما يختفي علاء من المنزل دون علم أفراد عائلته.

29.o: يأمر عبدالجبار رجاله بإحضار نادرة، ثم يثيرون الفوضى داخل النجع ﻹرهاب سكانه، ويعاقب عبدالجبار - أنس بسبب علاقتها مع عبيدة. ثم تقرر نادرة الذهاب لعبدالجبار درءا للمشاكل.

30.o: تعترف نادرة لعبدالجبار بكل ما فلعته لاضراره، فيتراجع عن المضايقات التى فرضها على سكان النجع ويسلمها ابنها يوسف. تخطط سكينة للانتقام منها. ثم تقوم نادرة بقتل عبدالجبار دفاعا عن نفسها بعد هجومه عليها.
